method: The Codex agent read all retained-hit context snippets in four batches of 100 and assigned each label and reason explicitly. Additional surrounding/full text was opened for ambiguous cases. No regex assigned labels; no external model API calls.
criterion: 至少一处暂定保留命中描述候选人能力、岗位任务或工作方式，而非仅机构/设施/产品系统特征；AI复核不是人工金标准
limitations: Single-agent semantic review; model judgments can be wrong and no independent human gold standard exists.
Equal allocation per term: pooled rate describes this review pack, not the corpus or labour market.
Boundary cases retained as uncertain: service-provider/department mentions, learning opportunities offered as benefits, and a bare language tag.
Technical targets and service-robot types, accommodation features, licensing and general organization descriptions are not automatically personal competence requirements.
human_field_integrity_check: Checked blankness only; did not read any completed human labels.
